title: EthernalHope
tagline: At EthernalHope, we are the experts in searching for missing persons through collaboration and decentralization.
description:
This project originated from many stories that exist of missing persons, from a relative of one of our team member.

In Latin America, the search for missing persons is an arduous task where information is not shared in a transparent or organized way to find the person.

That is why we decided to create a smart contract, where a civil non-governmental organization registers the information of a missing person and registers the clues of his or her wall through NFT.
how_its_made:
We deployed our contract on Polygon’s mainnet because of the very low costs of the blockchain.

We also use IPFS, using OrbitDB (WIP) to keep the registry censorship resistant and run our contract from the website, we also upload the images to IPFS (Private Node and Pinata) of the people and tracks, to avoid attacks.
